transcript.content:
I've identified the bug. The issue is in `modules/styles.py` where `style_paths.remove("do_not_save")` is called. The `"do_not_save"` value is only added to the set when styles are loaded using the glob pattern (with `*` in the filename, creating divider entries). When styles are loaded from a single CSV file (the common case), no dividers exist, so `"do_not_save"` is never in the set, causing a `KeyError`.

Both `get_style_paths()` (line 173) and `save_styles()` (line 212) have this same bug. The fix is to use `style_paths.discard("do_not_save")` instead of `style_paths.remove("do_not_save")` — `discard` silently no-ops if the element isn't present.
